component.name: YarmiplayTV
component.summary: Watch videos in sync with friends

description.p: YarmiplayTV lets you watch videos together with friends, wherever they are. Everyone in a room plays the same video at the same moment: when someone pauses, seeks or starts the next episode, everybody follows.

It works with Syncplay servers, so you can watch with friends who use the Syncplay desktop client, or with others on YarmiplayTV on their TV, phone or computer. Join the free public servers or your own.

ul.li: Play, pause and seek stay in sync for the whole room
Shared playlist: drag to reorder, shuffle, loop, save and load lists
Room chat and a "ready" check before you start
Open files, drop folders on the window, or use "Open with" on a video
Browse and search your Jellyfin and Plex libraries
Finds the room's file in your libraries or folders by itself
Built on mpv: plays almost any format, with styled subtitles and track switching

description.p: No accounts, no ads, no tracking. YarmiplayTV is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Syncplay project, Jellyfin or Plex, and it doesn't provide any videos: you watch your own files and media servers.

description.p: Phone and tablet voice match TV: one-tap mic in the player, capture and the microphone foreground-service type only while the mic is live so the privacy indicator clears when muted.

Stop holding the mic while muted (privacy indicator), fix voice audio playback routing and open-mic permission, and restore the Android playback notification when voice is connected without mic permission.
Ask for microphone permission when you tap Mic, Join voice after Leave (with Auto-join voice setting), and make skip listening cancel reliably when the file changes.
The picture-in-picture pause button on Android pauses playback.
The Google Play build is shrunk, obfuscated and optimized. Debug builds stay readable.
The Windows installer is one branded window, and launch updates on Windows use it.
Google Play crash reports now include native debug symbols and the deobfuscation file.

Fix Windows in-app updates: version.json offers the MSI again so 2.6.x and 2.7.0 can install the update; setup.exe uses jpackage /quiet when an .exe URL is used. Download page stays Store, setup.exe, portable zip.
Windows branded setup.exe on the GitHub release and download page (jpackage Exe), alongside the MSI, portable zip, macOS dmg and Linux deb.
Voice chat in Syncplay rooms on YarmiplayServerTV: Opus through the server, mute and volume per person, tap-to-talk on TV, mic and speaker pickers on every platform, and a new Windows installer.

On TV, returning to the Jellyfin library restores focus to the opened title, focused Saved/Recent room buttons are no longer clipped, Left/Right on a MyAnimeList show's buttons stays on that show, and Continue watching / Recently added use a vertical library-style grid. On phones and tablets, the launcher icon artwork is a little smaller.
On TV, the Jellyfin library grid shows more titles per row, keeps two rows on screen, and scrolls the focused poster fully into view.
The icon beside the app's name is a little smaller, and it no longer has a light edge.

The seek bar shows a picture of the moment you're pointing at, whether the video is on this device, on Jellyfin or Plex, or shared through the room. Subtitle files beside a video are loaded, and you can open one or drop it on the window. The icon beside the app's name is larger and keeps its background on every theme.
Scrolling through shows on TV stays in the same column. Library tiles on TV are smaller.
A season's episodes can be added to the playlist at once.
Grass uses the leaf green.
Downloads leave out unused icons. Appearance adds Ember, Grass, Sky, and Snow.
On desktop, arrow-key seeking no longer opens the player controls overlay.
Align the MyAnimeList Search button with the search field on Android TV.
On Android TV, player adjustment menus use the app theme and work with the remote, and Dismiss on the file-not-found card can be focused, activated with OK, and closed with Back.
Player menus show each adjustment with its current value and its own reset: subtitle size, timing and placement, audio timing, speed, zoom, picture, aspect, loop and filters.

Updates started from inside the app show download progress, and installation progress too: Windows shows the installer while it finishes, and Android shows progress while the update is handed over. The update window before the app opens uses the current icon.

Playback keys match mpv: speed, chapters, subtitle timing and size, picture adjustments, and Ctrl+Backspace to reset them. Page Up and Page Down go to the next or previous playlist entry when the file has no further chapter. Subtitle size is G and Shift+F; z and Z shift subtitle timing.
Adopt flat app icon with bold 70% hero play prism and zero margin across all platforms.
Make subtitles smaller or larger from the subtitle menu, or with z and Z, the same keys mpv uses.
The app icon fills its slot. A transparent margin around the tile made it look smaller than other icons.
On desktop, display Continue Watching and Recently Added media in wrapped rows instead of scrolling horizontally to the right.

Simplify app icon across all platforms: enlarge 3D faceted play prism and streamline glowing cyan orbital sync loop without outer wireframe TV clutter for optimal glanceability on mobile home screens and folders.

Deploy new 3D brand identity across all platforms: faceted play prism with widescreen cinema TV horizon and orbital sync, update Microsoft Store assets and banners, and fix launcher banner typography spacing.
On TV, accurately detect available updates and launch Google Play Store ready to update, scale down device key action button in room view, and allow independent room and player access.
Improve Android playback notification with full interactive seekbar, previous, play/pause, next, and exit controls via MediaSession.
Add a setting on TV to control in-player menu scaling with a smaller default size.
Improve portrait player: clean video overlay, dedicated room status card with repositioned ready button, and expandable full video title.
Improve the portrait video player layout, controls, and fullscreen toggle on Android phones and tablets.
Return the desktop main window to menus when entering picture-in-picture so you can browse freely while watching.
Prefer streaming larger complete files from peers when a local copy is smaller or incomplete, and prevent uninitiated player jumps from skipping the room.
Keep relayed files downloading in the background until complete (including while paused) and move relay download status to the controls bar once the video is open
Prevent seeker resetting to 0 on reconnection, restore dropped media streams, and test stability fixes.
Fix playback position resetting to 0 when disconnected and reconnecting, and restore unloaded media streams automatically upon reconnection.

Add exit option on the home menu for all devices. Add full exit button on PiP and player on TV. Add toggles for auto PiP and staying connected in background on Android (off by default on TV, on by default on phones and tablets). Add exit button to playback notification on mobile.
Fix desktop skip opening/ending button layout so it stays static in one place without moving or stretching during countdown.
Improved Save and Saved Playlists layout on mobile portrait. Added exit action to playback notification and in-app quit option to allow shutting down the background service.
Fix desktop player sidebar visibility and Android picture-in-picture transition stability.
Fix background playback service lifecycle and test stability.
Fix Android picture-in-picture auto-enter transition stability and test isolation.
Fix desktop player fullscreen navbar visibility and improve mobile portrait controls.
Seamless orientation switching between portrait and landscape without video reload or black screens.
Portrait mode player layout improvements on Android: avoid camera hole cutout over video, full video title, bottom-anchored player controls, and bottom navigation bar.
Auto picture-in-picture when leaving the app on phones and tablets, stay connected when minimized with notification playback controls, and What's New section.
Music library support, persistent mini player, portrait player, and saved playlists.
Faster Jellyfin library browsing and search, chat draft retained across tabs, 2s auto-play after switching episode, 2s seek notifications, and saved seek positions.

Links can be added to the shared playlist on phones and tablets: the link button beside Sort A to Z opens a field for one or several links at once. On the computer, the shared playlist keeps up smoothly when checking for local files, and clicking a row selects it immediately.

A Jellyfin on HTTPS at home works when it's found on your network or typed by its address: the app uses the name on its certificate, and reaches it at home even when that name leads to your router. A YarmiplayServerTV host's shared Jellyfin keeps working at home after the app restarts, and older Android TVs accept its newer Let's Encrypt certificates. On TV, OK presses MyAnimeList's Allow button instead of jumping to the top of the page, the shared playlist shows whole names and keeps its Sort and Undo buttons usable, and the player's Ready and Menus buttons let the video show through. On the computer, the chat's new-message count is a proper circle.
New messages in a room's chat no longer pop up over the video; they wait in the chat. To see them over the video as they arrive, turn on Settings > Syncing > Chat on the video.

On a TV, the home screen's notice of a new version and Settings > Updates' Open Google Play button open YarmiplayTV's page in the Play Store on the TV, instead of starting the update in the background or showing a QR code for your phone.
On a computer, the room panel's count of new chat messages now sits beside the Chat tab's name in your theme's colour, instead of a small red dot over it.

The TV player's controls fit in one row again: a single Menus button opens the menu you used last, and the tabs at its top switch to the shared playlist, the room, the chat, audio, subtitles or MyAnimeList.

Fixes for TV. A Jellyfin server the YarmiplayServerTV host shares on the Syncplay port now lists and plays at home too, where the router can't reach its own address from inside. Signing in to MyAnimeList works with the remote: the arrows move a pointer over the page and OK clicks, which brings up the keyboard in a text field. The player's buttons scroll when they don't all fit, so none are cut off, and its panels are quicker to use: Up opens the one you used last, tabs at the top switch between them, and Back or Menu closes them straight back to the video.

YarmiplayTV in your web browser, with nothing to install: open tv.yarmiplay.com/watch to join a room on a YarmiplayServerTV with HTTPS set up. It has its own player for MKV, MP4, AVI, TS and WebM with styled subtitles and DTS or AC-3 sound, plays from your device, Jellyfin and Plex or another viewer's copy through the server, skips openings and endings, and keeps MyAnimeList up to date, with the shared playlist, chat, saved rooms and themes as in the app.

The player follows your theme: its panels, sheets and buttons take the theme's colours, and what's written on the video (the title, the times, hints) is now white on see-through black, so it reads on any picture. The shared playlist shows each file's whole name instead of cutting it short.
Noire is now dark purple, matching NoireServerTV. The black and white theme is still there, renamed Monochrome.

Themes: choose Dark, Noire (true black and white, darkest on OLED screens), Light, or Match the system in Settings > Appearance, on phones, tablets, TV and computers. The whole app takes the new colours at once, title bar and system bars included, while the player stays dark over the video.

Sort A to Z in the shared playlist, on phones, tablets, TV and computers: alphabetical for everyone in the room, with episode 2 before episode 10, while the room stays on what it's playing. Undo puts the old order back, now on phones and TV too.

Find a show on the MyAnimeList screen and in the player's MyAnimeList panel: search MyAnimeList for any show, then add it to your list, change its status, score and episodes watched, or take it off your list.

In a room, pressing play right after switching to a video plays it: pressed while a stream is still opening, it plays once the video has loaded, and pressed just as the video appears, it's no longer paused again.
The Skip button stays in one place, just above the controls, whether they show or not, with a new look that matches the player.

Openings and endings found by listening when the file's chapters, your server's markers and AniSkip don't know them: the sound of an episode is compared with the episodes before and after it, and the song they share is skipped. Server episodes are listened to on Wi-Fi or Ethernet only unless you allow mobile data, and Settings > Playback can turn listening off.
A roomier join screen on phones: the server gets the whole width with the port and TLS under it, the public servers wrap, and saved rooms show their whole address.

Play the next episode, or add it to the room's playlist, straight from your MyAnimeList list, with every episode you have one press away; Settings in categories on phones and TV too; and F6 for a screenshot without the subtitles on desktop.

Openings and endings found also from the file's chapters and your Jellyfin or Plex server's markers, and marked on the seek bar; the Android home screen says when there's a new version (also from Google Play); and a What's new card that highlights within its rounded corners.
Dark window title bars on Windows and macOS, matching the app's dark theme whatever the system's mode.

Skip anime openings and endings: times from AniSkip for the episode MyAnimeList recognises (no account needed), a Skip button for 3 seconds as one starts, or automatic skipping as a room setting shared by everyone in the room on YarmiplayServerTV 1.7.3, remembered by saved rooms; watching alone, Settings decides.

A seek bar that shows the time you point at, with a picture of that moment for videos on your device; a desktop side list for the app's sections and home cards that show their text in full on desktop and TV; MyAnimeList sign-in inside the app on phones and tablets; a brief MyAnimeList update note in the corner; and video progress on the Windows taskbar.

Saved and recent rooms with quick switching and one-tap rejoining, automatic MyAnimeList season and part matching with a dedicated library screen, three-column room layout with full-height chat, in-app update installation, and What's new notes after each update.
A cleaner window while the desktop app updates itself on launch: the app's logo, the version and progress, and a quiet Skip for now (also Esc).
MyAnimeList is switched on in this build. Connect it from the new MyAnimeList card on the home screen, next to Syncplay, your media servers and the files on this device.

MyAnimeList: sign in and your list follows what you watch, even for shows numbered across seasons (with Undo), and rate shows or change their status from the player. Desktop picture-in-picture is now a floating window that keeps playing while you use the rest of the app (P, the button, or minimizing). The join form finds YarmiplayServerTVs on your network, and a DuckDNS server connects with TLS at home even without NAT loopback.

Previous and next buttons in the player move the room's playlist (desktop: B/N and the media keys). While one entry plays, the next is looked up ahead of time, and when only another viewer has it, its start is fetched through the file relay, so moving on starts at once. A new operator password now shows as soon as the room is created.

Create a managed room right from the join form; the room name and operator password each have their own copy button; the Room tab lists the shared playlist first, then chat, the people in the room, and last switching rooms.

Syncplay managed rooms: create a room only its operators control, identify as an operator with its password (remembered per server and room), and follow the operators otherwise; operators can mark others ready.

Picture-in-picture: leaving the app while a video plays on Android (phones, tablets and TVs that support it) keeps it playing in sync in a small window, and the desktop app has a picture-in-picture window (P, or minimizing) that stays on top while you use the rest of the app.
MyAnimeList: your list follows what you watch, including shows numbered across seasons, with Undo, ratings and status from the player.

A Player tab on phones, tablets and desktop that opens the player from any screen, preview frames for the videos in Files on this device, and on Android the TV's thin seek bar and a media volume slider in the player.

Screenshots from the player (camera button, F5 on desktop), a save button for relayed files, local files browsed by folder, automatic updates installed before the app opens on Windows, and clearer Syncplay connection errors, including a stop on an invalid TLS certificate.
File relay: the Streaming line shows and hides with the player controls.
File relay: a comma in the file name no longer leaves the player on Loading, and streaming keeps filling ahead of playback.
File relay: shows Streaming while it plays, and a progress bar while a slow link downloads the file.
File relay: a file opened directly is shared even without a media folder, and Android plays a relayed file instead of failing to open it.

YarmiplayServerTV support: hosts approve devices once, viewers without the file stream it from someone who has it, and a Jellyfin the host shares is added automatically. Nothing changes on other Syncplay servers.
Syncplay connects on mobile networks where the server refuses IPv6, by falling back to IPv4.
Hide room chat, block names for a session, and room privacy tips
Linux: .deb downloads and the Snap Store. Fixes the desktop app not starting on Linux systems set to a language locale such as en_US.UTF-8 (mpv_create failed). Volume control in the desktop player.
Volume control in the player bar: a mute button, a slider and the level. M mutes.
The player controls hide after two seconds unless the mouse is on them; the Hide button and H hide them by hand.
Several Jellyfin and Plex servers at once.
